notes: Fixed emails still occasionally moving to Trash while replying to a different one — a second, harder-to-hit version of the previous fix. Fixed Moderation's Artists-tab search silently showing "no results" on a dropped connection. Admin Notes now shows who last edited the note, and when.
mac_notes: Fixed emails still occasionally moving to Trash while replying to a different one — a second, harder-to-hit version of the previous fix. Fixed Moderation's Artists-tab search silently showing "no results" on a dropped connection. Admin Notes now shows who last edited the note, and when.
windows_notes: Redesigned the song detail view to be far more compact. Admin Notes are now a real history instead of overwriting the last note, shared between the song page and the artist's profile. Added a one-click Artist Web Search for impersonation checks, auto-loading ACR/Shazam results, and a shortcuts overlay that lights up every hotkey on screen. Fixed Bulk Approval Review, FP playback and genre-saving, and a search box that could overflow its column. The Moderation sidebar can now collapse like Tickets', with a visible warning if the connection drops while collapsed.
